_comment: Plan-my-day settings (decisions D24, D27, D28). No code here. The numbers are the AI's judgement, NOT measured: change them freely. wet_mm = a 6-hour block counts as wet from this many mm (stored values are in 0.1 mm steps, so use multiples of 0.1). min_blocks = shortest window worth showing, in 6-hour blocks. hours = [from, to) in the place's local time; a block is 'in hours' when its MIDPOINT is inside. To fit, floor((to - from) / 6) must be at least min_blocks (checked by a test).

custom.label: Custom
custom.blurb: You choose what counts as wet.

activities.label: Drying laundry
activities.blurb: Any rain counts, and clothes need about 12 hours.

activities.label: Cricket or sport
activities.blurb: Play stops at the first rain.

activities.label: Field work
activities.blurb: Light rain is fine, heavy rain stops work.

activities.label: Travel by road
activities.blurb: Any time of day; only heavier rain matters.
